content:
Last month there were reports that Apple is developing a brand-new, AI-powered shopping assistant for the Apple Store app on iPhone and iPad.

It appears the company is now rolling out this feature to some users in the form of an "early preview."

Inside the Apple Store app, some users are now seeing a brand-new chat icon appear in the bottom-right corner, replacing the traditional search icon. On that page, users can search for products or start a conversation with the "virtual shopping assistant."

Example prompts include:

  • The latest Apple products
  • Help me check the trade-in value
  • Explain carrier deals
  • Help me pick a watch
  • iPhone monthly instalment plans
  • Compare iPad lineups

The above image was provided by ShrimpApplePro on X, giving us an early look at the new design.

Apple explained in the fine print:

The shopping assistant inside the Apple Store app is not available to everyone. Apple says it is currently only open to some users as an "early preview." As for when it will roll out more broadly, there is no word yet.

What do you think about Apple adding this brand-new AI assistant to the Apple Store app? Would you use this feature? Feel free to leave a comment below and let us know.
